probe: SELECT tr.id, tr.tax_year, tr.status, td.doc_type, td.data_json FROM tax_returns tr LEFT JOIN tax_documents td ON td.return_id = tr.id AND (lower(td.doc_type) LIKE '%1099%' OR lower(td.doc_type) LIKE '%nec%') WHERE tr.user_email = :email ORDER BY tr.tax_year DESC

extra_probes.sql: SELECT tr.tax_year, tr.status, d.field_name, d.field_value FROM tax_data d JOIN tax_returns tr ON tr.id = d.return_id WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND tr.tax_year = 2025 AND (lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%1099%' OR lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%charit%' OR lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%payer%') ORDER BY d.field_name
